Name: Portrait Atelier

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.27

- Added Exclude my server to the Sniper results server filter.
- Enlarged the Results here button.

Author: Jacob5800
Name: Strategy Board Library
Punchline: Search and import strategy board share codes.
Description: Searches a local library of FFXIV Strategy Board share codes and provides a quick copy-to-import flow.
Changelog:
## 0.1.2.2

- Fixed FFXIVStrats URL imports by reading the site's strategy API instead of searching the initial HTML. Strategy page titles and share codes are retrieved directly.
- Added folders and encounter filters, plus Recently used first sorting. Copying a board's code records its use.
- Duplicate-code messages identify the saved board; JSON imports report duplicate counts.
- Added library file export and merge import, preserving folders, favorites and recent-use dates. A timestamped backup of the current library is saved before importing.

Author: Tataru-business
Name: Keybound Automation
Description: Reads Keybound Brawler prompts and answers with keyboard input. Open /tatarubrawler for the Keybound Automation interface. Auto queue on lobby entry repeats until Stop auto queue; the circular arrows start a counted manual loop. Diagnostic recording, automatic play, and play on MapID 1359 are enabled at startup.
Punchline: Automatically type Keybound Brawler prompts and optionally keep queueing.
Changelog:
## 1.0.8.16

- Removed Illegal mode's fixed 1.5-second wait before resubmitting the same visible prompt.
